# block-editing

<!-- okfreq:index:start -->
<!-- Generated by okfreq lint; edit requirement metadata instead. -->

- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-001 — The Edit button turns edit mode on and off and tidies up on exit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-001.md) — When a writer clicks the Edit button of a writable preview, the page SHALL switch edit mode on or off and show the new state on the button as its pressed state and its tooltip, post the new state to the host before it applies it, keep the reading layout unchanged, and on exit save the open block editor, clear the block selection and the hover outline and close the label rename field.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-002 — A horizontal rule has a tall invisible hit area](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-002.md) — The extension SHALL give every rendered horizontal rule a box 25 px tall (the 1 px line plus 12 px of transparent padding above and below, with the page spacing unchanged), so that a click within 12 px of the line opens the rule's block editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-003 — Edit-mode text box follows VS Code undo, redo, select-all and delete-line key bindings](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-003.md) — When a writer presses the VS Code key binding of undo, redo, select all or delete line in an open block or table-cell text box of the focused preview, the page SHALL apply that command to the text box through a command the extension contributes, so the key binding the writer set in VS Code applies.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-004 — Arrow keys, Enter and Escape drive block editing without the mouse](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-004.md) — When edit mode is on and no editor is open, the page SHALL move a one-block selection with ArrowUp and ArrowDown, open the selected block with Enter, and, when an editor closes through Escape or Cmd/Ctrl+Enter, leave the edited block selected; the keys SHALL work while the page itself holds the focus, and a window or tab that comes back SHALL restore the selection.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-012 — A read-only preview has no Edit button](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-012.md) — When a preview is read-only (untrusted workspace, file outside the workspace or standalone file), the extension SHALL render its toolbar without the Edit button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-014 — A click or Enter on a mapped block opens its editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-014.md) — When a writer clicks a rendered block in edit mode, or presses Enter or Space on a focused mapped block, the page SHALL open the editor of the mapped block under the click with previewEditOpen for its source lines instead of revealing its source, and show in the editor the source text or the error that the host returns in previewEditSource.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-017 — The hover outline shows what a click would edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-017.md) — While edit mode is on, the page SHALL outline with a dashed line the element that a click at the pointer or focus would edit: the whole list for a list item, the cell for a table cell, the code block for a fence and else the mapped block, and the preview shows the text cursor over every element that carries a source file and line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-021 — Clicking any part of an admonition edits its whole directive](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-021.md) — When a writer clicks the title or the body of an admonition in edit mode, the page SHALL open one editor on the complete directive source from the opening fence to the closing fence.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-023 — A click on an image block opens its editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-023.md) — When a writer clicks a plain image, or a raw img block, in edit mode, the page SHALL open the editor of that block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-026 — The editor opens with the caret at the clicked word](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-026.md) — When a writer clicks rendered text in edit mode, the page SHALL place the caret of the opened text box at the source position of the clicked text, found by matching up to 32 rendered characters on each side of the click, and at the end of the block text without trailing line breaks when no unique place is found.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-029 — The block editor is a labelled one-pixel frame that hides its rendered block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-029.md) — When a block editor is open, the page SHALL expose its frame as a region named "Raw Markdown editor" and its text box under the name "Raw Markdown block", draw the frame with a one pixel border in the focus colour around a monospace text box that switches off spell check and auto-correction and grows with its text, lay out the status line with the Done and Cancel buttons beneath, and hide the rendered block it replaces.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-033 — The status line shows the lines and keys, with Done and Cancel beside it](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-033.md) — When a writer opens a block editor, the page SHALL insert the editor frame in place of the block at once and, when the host sends the block's source, fill it with the text box, a status line that shows the line range and the keys of the editor, and a primary Done button beside a Cancel button.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-041 — One edit at a time: an open editor blocks other edits, opens and refreshes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-041.md) — While a block editor or a field editor is open, the extension SHALL refuse every action that would compete with it (a second editor, a block move, a block selection, a copy, a cut or a paste, a label rename, a thread change, a checkbox toggle and a refresh) with the reason of its row in the table below and change nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-042 — Typing is autosaved as the smallest single replacement](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-042.md) — When a writer types in a block editor, the extension SHALL autosave the last text 400 milliseconds after the last keystroke, unless it equals the text last posted, posting it as one previewEditSave with final false that the host writes as the smallest single replacement of the text last written.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-047 — Done, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter or leaving the text box commits the edit](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-047.md) — When a writer presses Done, presses Enter with Ctrl or Cmd in the text box, or moves the focus from the text box to something outside the editor frame, the page SHALL post the final previewEditSave of the text of the open editor and close the editor without any message when its text equals the original and nothing was autosaved.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-053 — Cancel and Escape restore the saved text](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-053.md) — When a writer presses Cancel or Escape in a block editor, the page SHALL close the editor, posting previewEditCancel only when an autosave already reached the document, after which the host writes the original text of the block back in one edit.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-058 — Every host source edit is one undo step, renders once and reports a failed apply](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-058.md) — When the host writes an edit of the source document for the preview, it SHALL make the edit one undo step, refresh the preview once for it, and answer an edit that VS Code does not apply or rejects with a reason that begins "VS Code could not apply" or with the text of the error.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-061 — Tab, Shift+Tab and Enter indent and continue lists, quotes and fences](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-061.md) — When a writer presses Tab, Shift+Tab or Enter in the text box of a block editor, the page SHALL indent or outdent every line touched by the selection, or continue the list marker, quote prefix or indentation of the current line, and leave the key to the text box when no rule applies.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-069 — Marker keys wrap a selection; Home, End, select-all and undo stay in the text box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-069.md) — When a writer presses a key in the text box of an open editor, the page SHALL give it the text-box behaviour of its row in the scenarios (wrap a selection, caret to the start or the end, select-all, undo, repeated spaces and Enter typed as they are, except in the alt text of an image, where it validates it), apply every text change as a native undoable edit and keep a key the editor handled from reaching VS Code.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-077 — Keys no editor handled still reach VS Code](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-077.md) — When a keydown is not one an open editor handled, the page SHALL NOT stop its propagation.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-079 — Arrow keys at the edges open the previous or next block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-079.md) — When a writer presses an arrow key with the caret at an edge of the text box of an open block editor, the page SHALL leave the editor, saving a changed text, and open the editor of the previous or next body block with the caret at its end or at its start, and otherwise leave the key to the text box.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-087 — Edit mode places an insert point with a plus button after every body block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-087.md) — While edit mode is on, the page SHALL place an insert point holding a plus button labelled "Insert a block here" after every top-level body block and after the properties table, and a click on the plus opens an empty insertion editor at that place.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-094 — The host inserts a new block with clean blank lines](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-094.md) — When the host writes a new block after a line, it SHALL put one blank line before it and one blank line after it (none after it at the end of the document), in the line endings of the document, and write nothing for an empty or whitespace-only text or for a line that is not in the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-102 — An empty body offers one Start writing button](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-102.md) — While edit mode is on and the body of a rendered document has no block, the page SHALL show one Start writing button, after the properties table when there is one, in place of the insert points, and open the first-block editor from it on a click or on Enter.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-109 — The up and down arrows of an insert point move its block](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-109.md) — While edit mode is on, the page SHALL give the insert point of every body block an up arrow labelled "Move the block above up" and a down arrow labelled "Move the block above down", and a click on an enabled arrow asks the host to swap the block with its neighbour.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-117 — The host swaps two blocks in one edit and keeps their separators](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-117.md) — When the host moves a block past its neighbour, it SHALL replace only the lines from the first block to the second block with the swapped blocks, keeping the blank separator between them, the final line break and the line breaks of each block where they were, and adding a blank line only where the swap would glue a block to a non-blank line.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-124 — Moves and clipboard edits are refused for ranges that do not match the document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-124.md) — When the ranges of a block move, the range of a copy or a cut, or the line of a paste do not match the document, or a move or a clipboard edit reaches into the frontmatter, or text lies between the two blocks of a move, the host SHALL answer with the reason of that case and change nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-127 — An included block is never moved, cut, copied, selected or pasted after](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-127.md) — When a move, a copy, a cut, a block selection or a paste would involve a block that comes from an {include}, the extension SHALL refuse it, the page by disabling the arrow, ending or emptying the selection or showing a notice and the host by answering with the reason of that case, and change nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-129 — The page applies a move result only for its own render](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-129.md) — When a previewBlockMoveResult names another document, revision or request than the page shows, the page SHALL ignore it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-130 — Alt+Up and Alt+Down move the focused block, also from the text box](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-130.md) — When a writer presses Alt+ArrowUp or Alt+ArrowDown on a focused body block in edit mode, the page SHALL request the move of that block and focus the block at its new place, and the move chord in the text box of a block editor does the same after saving the edit and reopens the editor with the caret where it was.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-139 — The chord is Cmd+Alt on macOS and Ctrl+Alt elsewhere](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-139.md) — When a writer presses an arrow key with Cmd+Alt on macOS, or with Ctrl+Alt elsewhere, in the text box of a block editor, the page SHALL read it as the move chord.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-140 — Shift+click and Shift+Arrow select a run of blocks](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-140.md) — When a writer Shift+clicks a body block, or presses Shift+ArrowUp or Shift+ArrowDown on a focused body block or on the selection, in edit mode, the page SHALL select a run of body blocks, from the anchor block to the clicked block or to the free end of the selection, and open no editor.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-148 — A block selection survives saves and is cleared by patches](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-148.md) — When the page applies a content patch, it SHALL clear the block selection unless a selection is waiting for the patch of a save, and it applies a waiting selection by position only if the number of body blocks is the one it was read at, while the properties table is never part of a block selection.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-156 — A block selection moves as a whole](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-156.md) — When a writer presses Alt+ArrowUp or Alt+ArrowDown with blocks selected and the focus on the selection, a bar of it or the page, the page SHALL post one previewBlockMove with the line span of the selection and the neighbouring block.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-166 — Cmd/Ctrl+C copies the exact Markdown of the selected blocks](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-166.md) — When a writer presses the platform copy chord with blocks selected in edit mode and no editor open, the page SHALL post previewBlocksCopy with the first and last source line of the selection and take the key from the browser, so that the host puts the exact Markdown of those lines on the clipboard.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-169 — Cut removes the selected blocks with one blank separator](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-169.md) — When a writer cuts selected blocks, the host SHALL put their Markdown on the clipboard and delete them together with their blank separator in the line breaks of the document, so that no gap of two blank lines and no glued blocks are left, and answering that nothing was removed when the document changed during the clipboard write.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-174 — Paste inserts the clipboard as new blocks after the selection or insert point](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-174.md) — When a writer presses the platform paste chord with blocks selected, or with an insert point focused, in edit mode and with no editor open, the extension SHALL insert the clipboard text as new blocks after the selection or the insert point, without the blank lines at both ends of the text, in the line breaks of the document, with one blank line before and after and without gluing them to their neighbours, and refuse with a reason, changing nothing, when the clipboard has no text or the document changed while it was read.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-191 — The host holds an open block edit and ends it when the block changes](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-191.md) — When a block editor saves for the first time, the host SHALL hold an edit lock for that block, and release it, running the page work that waited for it, when the final save is applied, the page reports the close of the editor or a reload, or the block changes in the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-193 — Page updates wait while an inline editor is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-193.md) — While the page has an inline editor open, the extension SHALL hold back the renders, theme changes, PlantUML work, link refreshes, include changes and properties table updates that would replace the page content, and deliver only the newest render of those that waited once the editor closes.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-205 — Open editors are saved before the page hides or leaves the document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-205.md) — When the page hides, closes or leaves the document (a followed link, Back, another document) or the writer turns edit mode off, the extension SHALL post the text typed in every open editor as a save before the page goes away, bounded by a wait of at most 1.5 seconds for the page's answer and 1.5 seconds for the saves to reach the document.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-216 — A refused open or save keeps the typed text and says why](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-216.md) — When the host refuses to open a block editor or to save its text, the extension SHALL change nothing in the document, answer the page with the reason of the refusal, and let the page show that reason while it keeps the text the writer typed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-227 — A thread reply or delete is refused while a block edit is open](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-227.md) — When the host holds an open block edit and receives a reply to, or the deletion of, an inline thread, it SHALL answer "Save or cancel the open Markdown edit before changing a thread." and change nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-228 — Opening, saving and closing an editor keep the reading position](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-228.md) — When a writer opens, saves or closes an editor, the extension SHALL keep the edited block, table or properties section at its screen position: the page scrolls by the palette height on opening and back on closing, and the final save carries the source line and the viewport top (pinLine and pinViewportTop) that the host puts back at the same viewport top on the next render.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-232 — Text edits apply in offset order](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-232.md) — When several text edits planned on the same text are applied, applyTextEdits SHALL apply them in offset order whatever the order they come in.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-233 — Overlapping or out-of-range text edits are refused](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-233.md) — When text edits overlap each other or lie outside the text, applyTextEdits SHALL throw a RangeError and change nothing.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-234 — Preview edits keep the line endings of the document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-234.md) — When the extension plans or writes back a preview edit, it SHALL treat LF, CR LF and a lone CR as line ends, count one more empty last line after a final line break, and keep the line ending that the edited text ended with, write the line breaks inside an edited multi-line block with the one line ending the block (or, for a block of one line, the document) already uses, including the CR LF endings of a table and the presence or absence of its final line ending.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-235 — A refusal is told apart from a plan](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-235.md) — When an edit operation returns a result, isRefusal SHALL be true exactly for a result that carries a refused reason.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-236 — previewEditModeChanged carries a boolean edit mode](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-236.md) — The host SHALL accept previewEditModeChanged only with a boolean editMode.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-237 — previewEditOpen needs an edit id and a line range](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-237.md) — The host SHALL accept previewEditOpen only with a non-empty string editId, positive integer line and endLine with endLine not below line, an insertAfterLine that is absent or a non-negative integer, and no save or pin fields.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-238 — previewEditSave needs both texts and valid optional fields](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-238.md) — The host SHALL accept previewEditSave only with string originalText and editedText, the editId and line range of a previewEditOpen, a boolean final when present, flush only as true, an insertAfterLine that is absent or an integer of at least 0, and pinLine with pinViewportTop (finite, within 100000 in absolute value) only on a final save.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-239 — previewEditCancel needs an edit id and a line range](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-239.md) — The host SHALL accept previewEditCancel only with the fields of a previewEditOpen.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-240 — previewBlockMove needs both ranges and a direction](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-240.md) — The host SHALL accept previewBlockMove only with four positive integer lines, a direction up or down and an optional pinViewportTop that is finite and within 100000.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-241 — previewBlocksCopy needs a line range](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-241.md) — The host SHALL accept previewBlocksCopy only with positive integer line and endLine.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-242 — previewBlocksCut needs a line range and an optional pin](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-242.md) — The host SHALL accept previewBlocksCut only with positive integer line and endLine and an optional pinViewportTop that is finite and within 100000.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-243 — previewBlocksPaste needs a line to paste after](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-243.md) — The host SHALL accept previewBlocksPaste only with a non-negative integer insertAfterLine, an optional positive integer pinLine and an optional pinViewportTop that is finite and within 100000.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-244 — previewEditClosed carries the id of the closed editor](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-244.md) — The host SHALL accept previewEditClosed only with a non-empty editId of at most 100 characters.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-245 — previewEditFlushed carries the flush id and a flag](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-245.md) — The host SHALL accept previewEditFlushed only with a non-empty flushId of at most 100 characters and a boolean flushed.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-249 — The editor events are kept in a short trace](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-249.md) — While a page runs, it SHALL keep its last 40 editor events in a trace, each with the time since the page started, the event name, and an optional detail and caller stack.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-250 — The trace names the nearest callers of an event](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-250.md) — When a trace event is recorded with a stack, callers SHALL name the nearest named functions of that stack, innermost first, joined by " < ".
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-252 — Overlapping or out-of-range planned edits leave the document unchanged](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-252.md) — When the edits planned for a move, a cut or a paste overlap each other or lie outside the text, the extension SHALL refuse the operation and leave the document unchanged.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-253 — Start writing is the keyboard selection of an empty document](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-253.md) — While edit mode is on and the body of the document is empty, the page SHALL make the Start writing button the keyboard selection, open the new-block editor on Enter or Arrow Down exactly as a click on it does, and show the hint "Enter to create a new block" under it.
- [SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-254 — Right and Left move the block selection down and up the structure](SwRS-MDOKFSTUDIO-BLOCK-254.md) — When edit mode is on and no editor is open, the page SHALL move the keyboard selection one level down with ArrowRight (a table to its first cell, an admonition, card or tab to its first inner block, the whole page to its first block) and one level up with ArrowLeft or Escape, move a selected table cell with the four arrow keys without wrapping, and open the cell editor with Enter.
